description.en: Heavy curtains and a folding screen shelter these quiet rooms from the guarded corridors. The windows overlook the courtyard.
description.zh-CN: 厚重的帘幕与一架屏风，将安静的房间和卫兵把守的走廊隔开。窗外是一座庭院。

惊讶的望着你.zh-CN: 克娄巴特拉没料到会有访客。

text.en: Cleopatra? I thought you were traveling.
text.zh-CN: 克娄巴特拉？我还以为你在四处游历。

text.en: I was. Then the palace decided I was essential. How did you get past the guards?
text.zh-CN: 原本是。后来，王宫觉得我不可或缺。你怎么绕过卫兵的？

text.en: Your Majesty? May I come in?
text.zh-CN: 陛下？可以进来吗？

text.en: What is it?
text.zh-CN: 什么事？

text.en: Ramesses says there's an intruder. We've been ordered to search every room.
text.zh-CN: 拉美西斯说有闯入者，下令搜查每个房间。

text.en: Then look somewhere useful. I haven't invited an assassin.
text.zh-CN: 那就去该查的地方找。我可没邀请刺客。

text.en: I still have to inspect the apartments.
text.zh-CN: 可我仍然得检查这几间屋子。

text.en: You plan to search my rooms?
text.zh-CN: 你打算搜查我的房间？

text.en: I'd rather annoy you than report an empty search to Ramesses.
text.zh-CN: 比起向拉美西斯报告一无所获，我宁愿先惹您生气。

text.en: Horus, behind that screen. Quietly.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，躲到屏风后面。轻一点。

text.en: I can get back out the window.
text.zh-CN: 我可以从窗户出去。

text.en: And introduce yourself to every guard in the courtyard? Behind the screen.
text.zh-CN: 然后，向院子里的每个卫兵自我介绍？到屏风后面去。

text.en: A difficult strategy to argue with.
text.zh-CN: 这个安排，还真不好反驳。

text.en: (Horus slips behind a folding screen. Cleopatra moves a lamp to leave it in shadow.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯闪到屏风后。克娄巴特拉挪开一盏灯，让那边藏进阴影里。）

text.en: All right. A quick look, then you can get back to your search.
text.zh-CN: 好了。看一眼，然后继续你的搜查。

text.en: (The guard checks the room, sees nothing unusual, and backs toward the door.)
text.zh-CN: （卫兵查看房间，没有发现异常，便退向门口。）

text.en: Thank you. Close the door on your way out.
text.zh-CN: 有劳了。出去时，把门带上。

text.en: (Horus steps out and nearly knocks over the lamp.)
text.zh-CN: （荷鲁斯走出来，险些撞翻那盏灯。）

text.en: Careful. I just convinced him there was nobody dangerous in here.
text.zh-CN: 当心。我刚让他相信，这里没有危险人物。

text.en: I make no promises about the furniture.
text.zh-CN: 至于家具安不安全，我可不敢保证。

text.en: Then let's leave while it still has a chance.
text.zh-CN: 那就趁它还有机会，赶紧走吧。

text.en: If we're all finished defeating the furniture, can we go?
text.zh-CN: 各位，要是已经打败了家具，我们可以出发了吗？

text.en: I'm coming with you.
text.zh-CN: 我要和你们一起走。

text.en: Just like that?
text.zh-CN: 就这么决定了？

text.en: I've stayed long enough to know who owns every locked door. I'd like to see somewhere else.
text.zh-CN: 我已经待得够久了，久到知道每扇锁着的门都听谁的。现在，我想去看看别的地方。

text.en: Then welcome aboard. We can argue about the route outside.
text.zh-CN: 那就欢迎同行。至于接下来去哪儿，我们出去再讨论。
